subject: Pairing sandbox + CoderPad links for Carlos Rivera (ML coding screen)
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Carlos Rivera <carlos.rivera@gmail.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 08 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pairing sandbox + CoderPad links for Carlos Rivera (ML coding screen)

Hi Carlos —

Thanks again for taking the time to interview with us. Confirming our live ML pairing screen on Friday, Apr 9 at 11:00am PT (link to calendar invite attached). I've provisioned an ephemeral sandbox environment where you'll run a short model-debugging/coding task. Two quick notes up front:

- Sandbox URL (temporary, expires in 6 hours): https://sandbox.redwood.dev/session/ab12cd34ef
- CoderPad (we'll use this for the final pairing submission): https://coderpad.io/p/ZX9QW2

Attached are a short readme and a small sample dataset to try locally before the screen ([Attachment: pairing_readme.md, sample-dataset.csv]). The environment includes python 3.10, PyTorch, and a tiny GPU-enabled container — no AWS creds required.

Please confirm you can access the sandbox and CoderPad. If you prefer not to use the GPU-backed sandbox we can fall back to a CPU container (just let me know).

Panelists: Dev Patel will be your primary interviewer for the coding portion; Laura Bennett will cover a brief systems/ops question. Neha Kapoor is on backup in case of timezone hiccups.

What I need from you by end-of-day today: confirm access, and paste one short command you used to verify the environment (e.g., `python -c "import torch; print(torch.cuda.is_available())"`).

Looking forward —

Evelyn Hart
Recruiting Coordinator, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: pairing_readme.md (text/markdown), sample-dataset.csv (text/csv), env-dockerfile.txt (text/plain)]

Subject: Re: Pairing sandbox + CoderPad links for Carlos Rivera (ML coding screen)

Evelyn —

Thanks, I can see both links and downloaded the readme. Quick question: will I need to load any SSH key into the sandbox, or is access token-based? I tried the verification command and got `torch.cuda.is_available() = False` on the first run — I may be on a laptop without GPU passthrough.

If GPU is required, happy to borrow another machine or accept the CPU fallback.

— Carlos

Subject: Re: Pairing sandbox + CoderPad links for Carlos Rivera (ML coding screen)

Carlos —

No SSH keys required for the ephemeral sandbox — access is token-based and tied to the session link Evelyn sent. If you see `torch.cuda.is_available() = False`, it's almost certainly because your local machine doesn't have GPU passthrough. The sandbox itself has a tiny GPU assigned for the session and will be available when you connect from the browser. To verify the sandbox quickly, paste the session URL into an incognito window and click "Start Session"; you'll get a temporary terminal where you can run the check.

If you want to test locally ahead of time, run the following inside the provided Dockerfile environment (we included env-dockerfile.txt in attachments):

- `docker build -f env-dockerfile.txt -t ri-sandbox-test .`
- `docker run --rm -it ri-sandbox-test python -c "import torch; print(torch.cuda.is_available())"`

I'll be hosting the session and will fall back to CPU-only tasks if there are any GPU flakiness.

See you Friday,
Dev Patel
Senior Software Engineer, Inference Runtime

Carlos —

Great, thanks for checking. No action needed on your end beyond joining the session at start time. I've pinned a short pre-reading note in the sandbox and included a single-line test you can run from the web terminal (`python -c "import torch; print(torch.cuda.device_count())"`).

Final logistics:
- Session: Fri, Apr 9 — 11:00am PT (30m total)
- Join via sandbox (preferred) or CoderPad (fallback)
- Interviewers: Dev (coding), Laura (systems), Neha (backup)
- Please have a one-line explanation ready for any performance tradeoff you make while coding (we care about thought process as much as final code).

I've attached the calendar invite and the small dataset again. If anything changes I'll update the session link and notify you.

Best,
Evelyn
